name: Eigener Speicher für Stufe 2 der Insert-Effekte

changes.note: DSP 0x01f0c166: R2 = stage 2 coefficients - stage 1 state (was 0x50)
DSP 0x01f0c16a: R3 = stage 2 state - stage 1 state (was 0x70)
DSP 0x01f0c178: R2 = R5 + R2, stage 2 coefficients from the state base (was R1 + R2, behind stage 1's coefficients)
DSP 0x01f0c1cc: [I0++] = R0, stage 2 gets the part's SDRAM buffer (was R6, 0)
DSP 0x01f0c1ec: R4 = 0xB4, stage 2 coefficient stride (was 0x1B4, the part block)
DSP 0x01f02448: heap 1 length, the heap ends where stage 2 starts (was 0x39FF, the rest of bank B)
DSP boot block: zero fill 0xff900cd0 up to 0xff908000 (was 0xff903ff0)
